name: Prism Runway Show💎
desc:
🎀 Become a PRISM STAR! 🎀

Welcome to the Prism Show, a stage where every color in the world comes together. You're a rookie model, fresh off your debut on this very stage. Are you ready to become the ultimate fashionista, a 'Prism Star,' by showcasing your unique color and personality?

✨ Dominate the runway with dazzling styles, perfectly matched to each show's ever-changing theme.
✨ Claim first place in style battles against other players with your sensational outfits.
✨ Share your finished looks on 'Prism Play' and connect with the community by admiring each other's fashion!

📣 Please report any bugs or provide feedback on the game through Group Forum or our Discord channel. (Shutdown = Update)

👍 Your likes and group follows mean a lot to us!
